description: Rural and Remote Health is an interactive resource (dashboard, viewer or map) listed in the DITRDCSA Data Catalogue under the Regional Data Hub group, published by Australian Institute of Health and Welfare (AIHW). This report on rural and remote health from the Australian Institute of Health and Welfare (AIHW) presents data on health risk factors, prevalence of chronic conditions, leading causes of death, and presence of health professionals according to remoteness area. Users can view access data as an interactive web report or downloadable data tables (Excel format). Data is available on Remoteness Area boundaries. Coverage is Australia, 2016 to 2020; spatial detail follows the source and is not stated in the entry. The catalogue lists the update frequency as not stated, the status as non-current, and the entry was last changed on 2023-08-21. Files and pages listed: HTML (1 resources), reached from the source page and the catalogue entry, with the CKAN API giving the metadata. Access is free of charge and open; the licence is CC-BY (version not stated). Caveats: the record was written from the catalogue metadata only, so the source page was not opened, the file contents were not checked, and many entries are HTML landing pages or PDF reports, not data files. It can support capacity and investment planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-catalogue-australia.
